LESSON: OUR HOME

Grade: PP2
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: SOCIAL
Topic 1.3: Our Home

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Our Home. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Identify different buildings and found at home in the 2.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Identify different buildings and found at home in the 2.
   In simple words: practise until you can identify different buildings and found at home in the 2. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Our Home using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Our Home in the examples.
2. Explain Our Home to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Our Home.
4. Show that you can: Identify different buildings and found at home in the 2.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Our Home using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Our Home important for a PP2 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Learners talk about uses of buildings found d) Appreciate buildings and buildings and structures at at home? structures. home
2. Learners view videos of buildings and structures at home
3. Observe charts of peoples working, buildings, 125 structures and tools used at home
4. Draw buildings and structures at home

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Identify different buildings and found at home in the 2.
